capabilities.models: PyTorch cross-sectional prediction pipeline with baseline training support

useful_components: mask-aware factor primitives and explicit tradability plumbing
a broad registered factor catalog that can be evaluated without copying formulas
lagged weights and explicit transaction-cost accounting
public ETF rank-IC reproduction with six source-preselected factors
documented research limitations and reproducibility checks
limitations: The repository explicitly says it is research infrastructure, not a production-ready live trading system.
The full paper-style A-share evidence relies on restricted Wind or Tushare data that is unavailable here.
Its synthetic demonstration is not evidence of alpha and produced negative performance in our smoke run.
Public ETF validation uses a small survivor universe and does not model delistings or point-in-time membership.
Several factors depend on VWAP or amount; our free snapshot supplies neither true field.
Cross-sectional testing over hundreds of factors creates severe multiple-testing risk unless the candidate family is fixed before results.
decision_scope: Use the pinned implementation in an isolated container. First test only the six factors preselected by the repository's public ETF script; audit all 213 mechanically but do not mine them for winners.
